# Announcer voice clips

`good_shot.wav`, `nice_shot.wav`, `three_points.wav` and `thanks.wav` were generated locally on 2026-10-29 with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0, https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M),
voice `af_heart`, 24 kHz mono, trimmed and peak-normalised. No text or audio left the machine and no third-party recording is included.

## Pie warning siren

`pie_alarm.wav` is an excerpt (first siren sound, 0.05 s to 2.5 s, converted to 24 kHz mono) of `siren.mp3` from "Sirens and Alarm Noise" on OpenGameArt
(https://opengameart.org/content/sirens-and-alarm-noise), released under CC0 1.0 (public domain, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); no attribution is required.
Source file SHA-256 `fabe96ad2116d310b38acc143780e1c47c3cb27227deda13f84ce8e3cfb2248b` (downloaded 2026-10-30).
